hook: Driverless pod cars: *35 km*, 64 stations planned for IT corridor
hook_b: Driverless pod cars: *35 km*, 64 stations planned for IT corridor
tldr: HMRL presented a Personal Rapid Transit System (PRTS) plan to Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju on Nov 18: Phase-I runs Kukatpally to Knowledge City via Raidurgam and Biodiversity Park, with 64 stations.

beats.what: HMRL showed the Chief Secretary a 35-km Phase-I pod car corridor with 64 stations.
beats.why: The government wants to ease IT-corridor traffic and link it with the Metro and RTC buses.
beats.care: The CS asked for a route map and action plan, built at the lowest possible cost.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 19): HMRL projects commuter demand of 3.94 lakh by 2030, about 10 lakh by 2050.

cards.q: Would you ride a driverless pod car to work?

qs: Would pods cut car trips in the IT corridor, or mostly pull riders off buses and autos?
Who pays under the PPP model being studied?

facts.t: HMRL projects about *10 lakh* pod car commuters by 2050, up from 3.94 lakh in 2030.
Phase-I would have *64* stations along the Kukatpally–Knowledge City route.

viz.verdict: HMRL's feasibility study projects demand more than doubling by 2040
Tender by December, line a year after (CM's target)

learn.t: PRTS = Personal Rapid Transit System: small electric pods on elevated tracks

watch: Whether the first corridor's tender is finalised by December, as the CM directed.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Hyderabad plans 35-km pod car network to ease traffic, link Metro

fact: Hyderabad plans *35 km* of driverless pod cars from Kukatpally to Knowledge City
twist: The CM wants the first corridor's tender finalised by December and the line ready within a year after.
